author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Giraffe head and neck in profile facing right, following the reference: the neck back rises diagonally from the bottom-left corner, the head top meets a 45-degree forehead running into a rounded muzzle, the jaw returns to the throat and the throat drops to the bottom edge; lens ear up-left, ossicone from the forehead corner. Naturally asymmetric. No Lucide match; line + cubic construction.
omissions: The ossicone knob is carried by the round cap; there is no eye (neither the reference nor the 9-unit head band has room for one).
